GAP Privacy Exported Types

group Gap_Privacy_Exported_Types

Defines

GAP_MSG_LE_PRIVACY_RESOLUTION_STATUS_INFO 0x00

Information msg type for resolution status. The structure of callback data is T_LE_PRIVACY_RESOLUTION_STATUS_INFO.

GAP_MSG_LE_PRIVACY_SET_RESOLV_PRIV_ADDR_TIMEOUT 0x01

Response msg type for le_privacy_set_resolv_priv_addr_timeout. The structure of callback data is T_LE_PRIVACY_SET_RESOLV_PRIV_ADDR_TIMEOUT_RSP.

GAP_MSG_LE_PRIVACY_MODIFY_RESOLV_LIST 0x02

Response msg type for le_privacy_modify_resolv_list. The structure of callback data is T_LE_PRIVACY_MODIFY_RESOLV_LIST_RSP.

GAP_MSG_LE_PRIVACY_READ_PEER_RESOLV_ADDR 0x03

Response msg type for le_privacy_read_peer_resolv_addr. The structure of callback data is T_LE_PRIVACY_READ_PEER_RESOLV_ADDR_RSP.

GAP_MSG_LE_PRIVACY_READ_LOCAL_RESOLV_ADDR 0x04

Response msg type for le_privacy_read_local_resolv_addr. The structure of callback data is T_LE_PRIVACY_READ_LOCAL_RESOLV_ADDR_RSP.

GAP_MSG_LE_PRIVACY_SET_MODE 0x05

Response msg type for le_privacy_set_mode. The structure of callback data is T_LE_PRIVACY_SET_MODE_RSP.

Enums

enum T_LE_PRIVACY_PARAM_TYPE

Define the privacy parameter type.

Values:

enumerator GAP_PARAM_PRIVACY_TIMEOUT

Time Controller uses a Resolvable Private Address before a new resolvable private address is generated and starts being used. Read/Write. Size is 2 octets. Value range: 0x0001 to 0x0E10 (1 s to 1 hour). Units: Second. Default value is 0x0384 (900 s or 15 minutes).

enumerator GAP_PARAM_PRIVACY_RESOLUTION_STATE

Resolution state. Read only. Size is 1 octet. Value is T_LE_PRIVACY_STATE.

enumerator GAP_PARAM_PRIVACY_RESOLV_LIST_SIZE

Total number of entries in the resolving list that can be stored in Controller. Read only. Size is 1 octet.

enum T_LE_PRIVACY_STATE

Define the privacy state.

Values:

enumerator LE_PRIVACY_RESOLUTION_DISABLED

Resolution disabled.

enumerator LE_PRIVACY_RESOLUTION_DISABLING

Resolution disabling.

enumerator LE_PRIVACY_RESOLUTION_ENABLING

Resolution enabling.

enumerator LE_PRIVACY_RESOLUTION_ENABLED

Resolution enabled.
